name: Hotel Management
overview: Hotel management is an exciting and diverse field that encompasses various aspects of managing and operating hotels, resorts, and other hospitality establishments. The profession revolves around providing exceptional guest experiences while ensuring the smooth functioning of all hotel operations. Modern hotel management involves front desk operations, housekeeping, food and beverage management, event planning, marketing, and finance.

topJobs.description: Oversees all operational aspects of the hotel and coordinates guest services, finances, marketing, and staff management.
Manages reception, guest services, reservations, and guest concerns during check-ins and check-outs.
Focuses on guest satisfaction, manages feedback and concerns, and builds guest loyalty.
Orchestrates conferences, weddings, and special events hosted by hotels.
topJobs.indiaSalary: INR 4-10 lakhs (mid-range); higher in five-star establishments

topJobs.description: Oversees dining facilities including restaurants, bars, and banquets.
topJobs.indiaSalary: INR 6-18 lakhs (mid-range); higher in luxury establishments

institutesIndia: Welcomgroup Graduate School of Hotel Administration (WGSHA), Manipal

careerLadder: Excel in high school, particularly in business studies, communication, and languages
Pursue Bachelor's degree in Hotel Administration or Hospitality Management
Engage in internships, practical training, or part-time hospitality work
Pursue Master's degree in Hotel Management for specialization and leadership roles
Explore diverse career paths as hotel managers, event planners, or revenue managers in luxury hotels, resorts, or consulting firms
